scripts.start: concurrently "cd backend && cross-env NODE_ENV=development nodemon server.js" "cd frontend && yarn start"
scripts.frontend: adb reverse tcp:8080 tcp:8080 && cd frontend && yarn start
scripts.frontend-production: adb reverse tcp:8080 tcp:8080 && cd frontend && yarn production
scripts.test: concurrently "cd backend && yarn test" "cd frontend && yarn test"
scripts.install-all: cd frontend && yarn install && cd .. && cd backend && yarn install && yarn global add cross-env
